card.name: Mixed spots before a missing 'pure' word
card.fires_on: Mostly word pieces inside names or spelled-out words (Chakrabarti, Chopra, Kasap, Mirza, pyrimidinyl), and a few linking words like 'by' or 'in' after a verb. The next word is not predictable from the marked word itself.

modes.label: Inside personal names
modes.description: Early pieces of South Asian or Turkish surnames and given names, just before the rest of the name.
